An outcome in a deployed target exists only after release. Discovery leads are the workspace and checkout, available Node.js environment, project conventions, and relevant runtime documentation; no team, channel, internal site, private repository, owner, or sensitive locator was supplied. These are leads, not verified facts. Discovery should establish available evidence and runtime facilities before settling the questions above; defaults are recorded assumptions, and no questionnaire is needed for facts evidence can resolve.
